Teagle Hall

Teagle Hall was a gift of Mr. and Mrs. Walter C. Teagle (class of 1899). It features a Pool, a multi-purpose room where many Group Fitness classes, Physical Education classes, and club practices are held, and two separate Fitness Centers; Teagle Downstairs and Teagle Upstairs. Teagle is also the home of numerous administrative offices for Cornell University Athletics.

Teagle Hall is open to the entire Cornell Community. However, some recreational opportunities require a membership.

Teagle Equipment Issue Room

The Teagle Issue Room is located in front of the restroom and changing facilities, in between the East and West entrances on ground floor. An Issue Room employee is always present in the building during operating hours. If they're not available at the Issue Room during your arrival, please wait for their return. At the Issue Room, you can request general information or checkout equipment to use until the end of the day. Some affiliation or time restrictions may apply. Equipment Checkout & Rentals
